note: Bennett County SD: no official county zoning district service found in ArcGIS Online/Hub or county GIS pages; the county's GIS is property-oriented and third-party portals only mention zoning. City of Martin (county seat, largest city) publishes its zoning map only as a PDF (martin-zoning-map-2024.pdf / 2022 map), which is not queryable. Bennett County zoning districts are therefore viewer/PDF-only.
